editorial:
You are dropped into a messy love triangle that keeps growing. Vatelin and Lucienne seem happy, but their friend Rédillon has been chasing Lucienne for years. Then Pontagnac, a smooth-talking womanizer, starts flirting with her too. Instead of getting mad, Vatelin actually enjoys watching the chaos unfold. Things get wild when Maggy, an old English lover, shows up and threatens to hurt herself if Vatelin won't meet her. Lucienne has promised to take a lover the moment she catches her husband cheating. The whole thing feels like a fast, silly farce full of awkward moments and sharp jokes.

The acting is lively and the timing is quick, so the jokes land well. The story moves fast and never slows down, which keeps you laughing. On the downside, some characters feel a bit cartoonish, and the plot can get confusing if you blink. Still, if you enjoy classic French comedy and silly relationship drama, this is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the love triangle collapses into chaos. Maggy's blackmail forces Vatelin into a corner, and Lucienne finally gets proof of his old affair. True to her word, she decides to take a lover, and the question of who becomes the 'turkey' gets answered in a funny twist. Instead of a clean winner, everyone ends up tangled in their own mess, and the last joke lands on the men who thought they were in control. You are left laughing at how nobody really wins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly relationship comedies and French farce.
